payload.title: 15 Best Santorini Wedding Venues With Caldera Views
payload.excerpt: Santorini wedding venues with a caldera view sit in four parts of the island: Oia, Imerovigli, Pyrgos and the inland villages, and Akrotiri.
key_takeaways: Choose Oia or Imerovigli for a small terrace ceremony, and a winery when a long dinner matters as much as the cliff edge.
Most cliff-top ceremony spaces hold between 15 and 60 guests, so a larger guest list points to a full-property buyout, a winery terrace or the open-air space at Grand Ambassador in Akrotiri.
Several venues publish full-property buyouts or a hotel take-over, while others publish no capacity at all, so ask every venue the same questions in writing.
Greek summers bring frequent heatwaves and a wildfire season from June to September, and Santorini sits in an active seismic zone, so plan shade, timing and a fallback for your date.

faq.q: Which part of Santorini suits a wedding?
faq.a: It depends on your guest list and the setting you want. Oia's published ceremony spaces run from 25 guests on the Epitome Sunset Terrace to 60 seated at Botrini's, while Imerovigli, the "Balcony on the Aegean", has Katikies Chromata on its highest point. The wineries suit a ceremony and dinner in one place, and Grand Ambassador in Akrotiri publishes outdoor space for up to 250 guests.

faq.q: Which Santorini venues have a caldera view?
faq.a: All 15 venues in this guide describe a caldera view. In Oia, Katikies Santorini's Gea House looks over the caldera and the volcano; in Imerovigli, every room at Kapari faces the caldera; and Venetsanos Winery's Upper Terrace overlooks it.

faq.q: Are there small wedding venues in Santorini for intimate groups?
faq.a: Yes. Canaves lists 25 guests on the Epitome Sunset Terrace and 30 on the Oia Suites Panorama Balcony, Kapari takes events for up to approximately 30, and Grace's Villa seats 15. Katikies offers micro weddings for small groups.

faq.q: Which Santorini venues can host 100 guests?
faq.a: Grand Ambassador has outdoor space for up to 250 guests, a Canaves Epitome buyout takes up to 170 and a Canaves Oia Suites buyout up to 120. Venetsanos Winery seats about 100 on its Upper Terrace, and Botrini's Restaurant at Katikies Santorini holds 100 standing.

faq.q: Can we get married at a winery in Santorini?
faq.a: Yes. Santo Wines in Pyrgos hosts weddings with the caldera as the backdrop, and Venetsanos Winery's Upper Terrace hosts the ceremony and the reception.

faq.q: Can we book a Santorini venue for exclusive use?
faq.a: Some venues publish it. Canaves lists full buyouts of three Oia hotels, Katikies lists a hotel take-over among its event enquiries, and Grace Hotel's venue fee includes exclusive use of the selected event spaces. For the others, confirm in writing.

faq.q: How do guests get to Santorini?
faq.a: Most fly. Visit Greece lists a 50-minute flight from Athens and 1 hour and 30 minutes from Thessaloniki. Guests arriving by ferry should expect stairs with luggage and possible delays in strong winds.

faq.q: When should we get married in Santorini?
faq.a: Each period brings something different. At Naxos, the nearest official station, June to August are the driest months and July and August the hottest, and summer heatwaves are frequent. May and October fall outside the June to September wildfire season, with mean maximums of 22.1°C and 21.9°C at Naxos, though October is wetter.

faq.q: Can Australians legally get married in Santorini?
faq.a: Plan the legal steps first. As at November 2026, Smartraveller says you may need a Certificate of No Impediment, and a marriage valid in Greece that would also be valid under Australian law is in most cases recognised in Australia.
